_comment: Known-accepted Android attack surface for engcrm-mobile, seeded 2026-08-04 as part of adapting notes-world's automated security pipeline. android-static-checks.mjs and android-dynamic-checks.sh diff the current app against this file — anything NEW gets flagged as a finding. Update this file deliberately (with a reason in the commit message) when you intentionally add an exported component or permission; do not update it just to silence a finding you haven't looked at. Component names are the fully-qualified android:name as it appears in Gradle's merged manifest (app components resolved with the package prefix, library components already fully-qualified) — this is also what android-dynamic-checks.sh normalizes dumpsys output to.

exportedComponents.name: de.christopherrehm.engcrm.MainActivity
exportedComponents.reason: launcher activity + engcrm:// deep link, required

exportedComponents.name: androidx.profileinstaller.ProfileInstallReceiver
exportedComponents.reason: standard AndroidX profileinstaller library component, not custom app code

exportedComponents.name: com.google.firebase.iid.FirebaseInstanceIdReceiver
exportedComponents.reason: pulled in transitively by expo-notifications' Firebase Cloud Messaging dependency. exported=true but gated by android:permission="com.google.android.c2dm.permission.SEND" (signature-level, held only by Google Play Services) — not actually reachable by arbitrary third-party apps despite the exported flag. Verified in the merged manifest 2026-08-04.
